name: Wedge Holdings CO., LTD.
summary: Wedge Holdings CO., LTD., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the finance and content businesses in Japan and South-East Asia. The company offers motorcycle leasing financing services for the purchase of motorcycles. It also engages in the publication editing activities; planning and development of card games; and production and distribution of company owned contents and music labels. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Wedge Holdings CO., LTD. is a subsidiary of Showa Holdings Co., Ltd.
